reviews.review: This has got to be one of the jankiest games I have ever played. Just jank, jank, and more jank. Your character can clip through objects and guards, several objects you are supposed to pick up are just floating around in the air, picking up objects often does not work, pressing Q to break guards' necks did not work for me, there are no animations for lock picking or cutting wire, stabbing animations are atrocious, level design is terrible, you can fall right through rooftops by clipping through them, shadowing effects are poor, texture pop-in is prevalent, there are constant frame rate drops, and pressing the button to load a game can cause an infinite loading screen where you are forced to quit the game. There is also no manual save, which is imperative for stealth games in my opinion. And checkpoints (if there are any) must be extremely far away because I could not tell if the game ever saved unless you complete an entire level. You also cannot remap the controls and you must quit playing and exit back to the main menu to adjust the options. Mouse sensitivity is also too high and the mouse sensitivity slider is already lowered as low as it can go. Combat is also absolutely terrible and janky and shooting guns feels extremely weak and non-impactful. Objectives also stop showing on-screen, which leaves you with no idea where to go. Overall, this is a terrible gaming experience in my opinion that should be avoided.
reviews.developer_response:
Thanks for the detailed breakdown. It sounds like the core issues you ran into were clipping bugs, missing animations, inconsistent interactions, poor performance, weak combat feel, and a lack of basic QoL features like manual saves and control remapping. I appreciate you taking the time to list everything — this gives a clear picture of where the experience fell apart for you.

I will address these in the next update 

Thanks!
